claim: RDS Extended Support is available for up to 3 years past the RDS end of standard support date of a major engine version; after that, if you have not upgraded, Amazon RDS upgrades the major engine version automatically. RDS for MySQL 5.7 is an exception: its end of standard support date was February 29, 2024, and major version 5.7 reaches its end of Extended Support on June 30, 2029.

evidence.quote: RDS Extended Support is available for up to 3 years past the RDS end of standard support date for a major engine version.
After this time, if you haven't upgraded your major engine version to a supported version, then Amazon RDS will automatically upgrade your major engine version.
For example, the RDS end of standard support date for RDS for MySQL version 5.7 is February 29, 2024.
For example, minor version 5.7.44-RDS.20240529 reaches its end of Extended Support date in September 2025 while major version 5.7 reaches this date on June 30, 2029.

qualifiers.scope: per major engine version, after the RDS end of standard support date
qualifiers.condition: RDS for MySQL 5.7 runs longer: end of Extended Support June 30, 2029

note: adjudicate-26: currency vote found the 2026-06-17 What's New item (MySQL 5.7 Extended Support to June 30, 2029); the exception is grounded in the RDS for MySQL versions page.
